text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
I consulted with Shakur before. I told 
her, "I want to try getting my ears 
pierced to gain a fearless heart."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
However, it was brushed off with a 
"Doesn't suit ya." Hehe, quite harsh, 
wouldn't you say?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Still, right now—I'm grateful for those 
words. Deeply so.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
...I was trying to find a shortcut to 
acquire a heart that knows no fear...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
That gave me the chance to reconsider. To 
me, "It doesn't suit ya" is a harsh yet 
deeply kind remark.
